units.source_text: 到了三月里，有的樱花正开，有的樱花已谢，飞花遮蔽天空。

en.t: When the third month came, some cherry blossoms were in full bloom, others had already fallen, and drifting petals covered the sky.

units.source_text: 但总的看来，正是春光鼎盛之时。

en.t: Even so, taken all together, it was the very height of spring.

units.source_text: 玉鬘尚侍邸内昼长人静，闲寂无聊。

en.t: At the residence of Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, the days were long and still, quiet, lonely, and dull.

units.source_text: 女眷们走出轩前来看看春景，也不会有人非难。

en.t: If the women stepped out to the veranda to look at the spring scenery, no one would have found fault with them.

units.source_text: 两位女公子此时年方十八九岁，都长得容颜姣好，品性优良。

en.t: The two young ladies were then only eighteen or nineteen, both lovely in face and excellent in character.

units.source_text: 大女公子相貌堂皇高雅，而又娇艳妩媚，显然不像是臣下的配偶。

en.t: The elder daughter looked stately and elegant, yet also bright and charming, plainly not like someone destined to be the wife of a mere subject.

units.source_text: 她身穿表白里红的褂子，外罩棣棠色衫子，色彩适合时令，非常可爱。

en.t: She wore a robe white on the outside and red within, with a kerria-colored layer over it, colors perfectly suited to the season and very lovely.

units.source_text: 那娇媚之相连衣裙上都泛溢出来。

en.t: Her enchanting beauty seemed to overflow even into the folds of her garments.

units.source_text: 其风韵之闲雅，竟可使别人看了自感羞耻。

en.t: The quiet elegance of her grace was enough to make anyone who saw her feel ashamed of themselves.

units.source_text: 二女公子身穿淡红梅色褂子，外罩表白里红的衫子，头发像柳丝一般柔美可爱。

en.t: The younger daughter wore a pale red plum-colored robe with a white outer and red-lined layer over it, and her hair was soft and lovely like willow threads.

units.source_text: 人都觉得：她的姿态之苗条与清秀、性情之稳重与沉着，实胜于大女公子；而姿色之艳丽，则远不及乃姐。

en.t: Everyone felt that in slender grace, clear refinement, and calm steadiness of nature she truly surpassed her elder sister, though in radiant beauty she fell far short of her.

units.source_text: 有一天，姐妹两人下棋，相向而坐。

en.t: One day the two sisters were playing Go, seated facing each other.

units.source_text: 钗光鬓影，互相照映，景象煞是好看。

en.t: The gleam of their hair ornaments and the shadows of their side locks reflected each other, making a wonderfully beautiful scene.

units.source_text: 幼弟藤侍从当见证人，坐在近旁。

en.t: Their young brother, Fuji no Jijyu, sat nearby as the witness to the game.

units.source_text: 两个兄长向帘内窥探一下，说道：“侍从大受宠爱，当起下棋的见证人来了！”

en.t: Their two elder brothers peeped inside the blinds and said, “Jijyu is very much favored, even serving as witness to the Go game!”

units.source_text: 便大模大样地在那里坐了下来。

en.t: Then they sat down there quite boldly, as if perfectly at ease.

units.source_text: 女公子身边的侍女都不知不觉地整一整姿势。

en.t: The waiting women beside the young ladies all unconsciously straightened their posture.

units.source_text: 长兄左近中将叹口气说道：“我在宫中职务忙得很，不及侍从之能得姐妹们信任，真是遗憾！”

en.t: The eldest brother, the Sakon no Chujo, sighed and said, “My duties at court keep me so busy that I cannot match Jijyu in earning my sisters’ trust. It is truly regrettable!”

units.source_text: 次兄右中弁也说道：“我们当弁官的，宫中的职务更忙，竟顾不到家事了。

en.t: The next brother, the Uchuuben, also said, “For those of us serving as benkan officials, court duties are even busier, and we cannot even attend to family matters.

units.source_text: 但总会蒙原谅的吧。”

en.t: But surely we will be forgiven.”

units.source_text: 两女公子听见两兄长说这些话，停止下棋，难为情起来，娇羞之相甚是可爱。

en.t: When the two young ladies heard their brothers say this, they stopped playing Go and grew embarrassed, and their shy, bashful manner was very charming.

units.source_text: 左近中将又说：“我出入宫廷时，常常想起：有父亲在这里才好。”

en.t: The Sakon no Chujo went on, “Whenever I go in and out of the palace, I often think how good it would be if Father were here.”

units.source_text: 说着，流下泪来，向两个妹妹看看。

en.t: As he said this, tears fell, and he looked toward his two younger sisters.

units.source_text: 这左近中将年约二十七八岁，用心十分周到，常在考虑两个妹妹的前程，总想不负父亲遗志。

en.t: This Sakon no Chujo was about twenty-seven or twenty-eight, very thoughtful and attentive, always considering the future of his two younger sisters and wishing not to fail his father’s last intentions.
